finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. Scene: A pale blue lake viewed from a small stony shore, one broad light beige rock platform enters from bottom left, dark ochre narrow side plane, muted-teal reed clump at right, pale blue-gray far bank. Cyan and blue-green limited horizontal water strokes, generous white sparkling reserved gaps, no boat, bridge, people or mountains. Cool palette but sunny. Moderate simple brushstroke illustration with broad color masses. Palette: 67 pale cyan; 65 blue-green; 63 bright cyan blue; 143 extremely pale blue-gray; 58 muted teal; 25 very pale gray-beige; 95 ochre brown. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.

instruction_pages.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one large legible teaching page, 2x2 grid FOUR LARGE panels. D4 autonomous composition helper, not a copy-along finished picture. Panels are thumbnail choices, large masses, structure, palette/order. Each diagram is only one possible solution.  Attached artwork is composition and palette reference, NEVER copy finished colors into early stages. S002 sunlit natural brushstroke marker style, broad masses, irregular organic plant strokes and white gaps, no circular leaf blobs or dot borders. Title exact Chinese: S002-029 清蓝岸边的一天 · 构思与结构. Top tool codes: 67,65,63,143,58,25,95. Each panel has given numbered Chinese title and ONLY ONE SHORT readable Chinese instruction hint, not the entire paragraph below; drawings occupy most panel area. White page, thin gray dividers, generous margins. The full instructions below constrain what to illustrate, not all to print. Palette: 67 浅青蓝（照片观察）; 65 蓝绿色，非很浅冰蓝（照片观察）; 63 较鲜的青蓝色（照片观察）; 143 极浅青灰、蓝灰（照片观察）; 58 灰调青绿，非浅薄荷绿（照片观察）; 25 很浅的灰米色、灰肤色（照片观察）; 95 赭棕、黄棕（照片观察）. Panel instructions: 1 两种小稿 — Show TWO small pencil thumbnails with different focal placement or framing for this same subject, mark A and B, genuinely different possible layouts, no final colors. 2 三组大形 — Chosen-example thumbnail only; show pale flat masses for main subject, support and reserved white; add small light-source arrow and focal dot. 3 结构与留白 — Large pencil STRUCTURE STUDY: 冷色水面靠水平笔触与预留反光保持明亮；暖石岸只需顶侧两面，岩缝不是主要目标。 Show critical connections and white gaps, no dense foliage. 4 配色与顺序 — Separated numeric color swatches using ONLY 67,65,63,143,58,25,95 and a SIMPLE chosen-example block-in, NOT final rendering. Printed note: 先构思，再按需看示意。. Footer exact: AI教学示意 · 详细操作见正文. Transparent student alcohol/oil markers on 16.5cm paper, light-to-dark, reserve white before color. No opaque white over dark, no smooth digital gradients, no thick black outline. No extra subjects.
